documentation.purpose: Official RRC identifies ODP datasets and row grain
Official H-10 units and source field definitions

limitations: One explicitly selected UIC with an inclusive bounded reporting period; exact-UIC inventory revalidated against preserved lookup identity.
ODP supplies no annulus pressure or original H-10 document revision ID.
Source reports are not independently validated measurements.
Current status, sustainable capacity and BHP are not inferred.

BHP/SRT test-report sidecars are exact-UIC report inventories not limited to the reporting period: one row per source record (the source does not document how many rows one test produces), without test documents or pressure series; psia and psig are kept as labelled and never converted.

Casing and plugging sidecars are exact-API filing records for the selected inventory row's own API (basis inventory_api_no), not limited to the reporting period; record_sequence is a filing sequence; presence or absence of rows is not a statement about casing, cementing or plugging status. Units, meanings and disclosed source conflicts (C2-C7) are cited in wellbore_dictionary.json; nothing is converted.

evidence_relations.json lists typed relations derived at export from this version's own records and source files (ADR 004 §3); query version 5 queries exactly the version 4 targets. Relations assert exact string equality of source keys only; matched does not establish one physical wellbore, and no relation states casing, cementing, plugging, compliance or hydraulic communication.
manifest.normalized_payload_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify({schemaVersion,artifactId,inventory,injectionMonthly,qualityReport,dataDictionary}), in this key order, excluding manifest to avoid circularity
